arguments.name: tlc-verdict
arguments.source:
(lambda (input)
  (let* ((violates (or (search "is violated." input) (search "Temporal properties were violated" input)))
         (holds (search "No error has been found." input))
         (verdict (cond (violates "violates")
                        (holds "holds")
                        (t "error")))
         (name (let* ((marker "Error: Invariant ")
                      (pos (search marker input)))
                 (if pos
                     (let* ((start (+ pos (length marker)))
                            (end (search " is violated." input :start2 start)))
                       (if end (subseq input start end) "-"))
                     "-"))))
    (format nil "verdict ~a~%invariant ~a" verdict name)))
arguments.note: Parse a TLC run log into verdict (holds/violates/error) and violated invariant name.
